title: Unused variable g in test_stats_replay_identity — the core test package should not compile
detail: g is declared and never used in this test. Odin treats unused locals as compile errors, so core/stats_test.odin should fail to build — contradicting the PR's 'odin test core — 164 tests green' claim. At minimum it is dead code.
recommended_fix: Write r, _, h := test_seed_fixture(&replay, &cat) (blank the unused id), or reference g in an assertion like the sibling tests do.

title: CI PP_DEBUG gate builds the app only — the PP_DEBUG harness code has no compile coverage
evidence:
# Story 5.7 (W10, Perkins r1): the PP_DEBUG overlay build must stay
      # compile-green in CI — two whole files rot silently otherwise. The
      # overlay is compile-gated, so this build also proves the gate itself
      # holds (the plain build above proves the release shape).
      - name: PP_DEBUG overlay build (compile gate)
        run: odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin
---
harness/overlay.odin (whole file compile-gated):
when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) {
detail: The only CI PP_DEBUG build compiles the app. harness/overlay.odin and the PP_DEBUG overlay-check block in harness/main.odin compile solely under the define, so they can rot while CI stays green — the exact failure the new step claims to prevent.
recommended_fix: Add a CI step building the harness with -define:PP_DEBUG=true (shadow ODIN_ROOT), or narrow the comment to the app's overlay file only.

title: CI invokes tools/harness.sh stats-check but tools/harness.sh is never updated in this diff
evidence:
- name: Stats stream replay-identity (live == replay)
        run: |
          tools/harness.sh stats-check pause
          tools/harness.sh stats-check qos_contention
---
_pr_body.md Files changed (excerpt; the list contains no tools/harness.sh entry):
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — PP_DEBUG build gate (W10) + stats-check for pause/qos_contention (N1).
detail: The new CI step calls tools/harness.sh stats-check, but this diff modifies no harness.sh and the PR's files-changed list omits it. If the wrapper dispatches verbs explicitly (preview-check suggests per-verb cases), the step fails in CI.
recommended_fix: Add a stats-check case to tools/harness.sh in this PR and list it under Files changed, or verify the wrapper forwards unknown verbs.

title: Stale comment claims the overlay appends to the stream builder without --stats-out; the code passes nil
detail: The comment says the overlay appends records into the builder even without --stats-out ('harmless'); the loop passes nil sb ('compute-only, no memory growth'). The code is correct, the comment is false; the never-flushed header also leaks.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the comment to match the nil-builder path, and skip stats_write_header (or free the builder) when stats_live is false.

title: Dead before / _ = before pair duplicated in both new test loops
detail: before is captured then explicitly blanked in both new test loops — copy-paste from stats_stream_of, where before slices events for the hash. Here it is pure noise suggesting a hash slice that does not exist.
recommended_fix: Delete the before := len(...) and _ = before lines from both loops, or use before in a state_hash call to truly mirror the emit path.

title: node_slot ok discarded in draw_heat_tints while pipe_slot ok is checked
evidence:
ps, ok := pp.pipe_slot(topo, p.pipe)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		sa, _ := pp.node_slot(topo, topo.pipe_a[ps])
		sb, _ := pp.node_slot(topo, topo.pipe_b[ps])
		ax := node_screen(v, topo.node_pos[sa])
		bx := node_screen(v, topo.node_pos[sb])
detail: pipe_slot's failure is handled, but both node_slot results are discarded and immediately used to index node_pos — a failed lookup draws from an unvalidated slot instead of skipping, unlike the guard two lines above.
recommended_fix: Propagate both node_slot oks and continue on failure, mirroring the pipe_slot guard.
